scope.population: Valid emitted known-direction public-trade-trigger decisions in prospectively named cohorts, not the complete public trade population.
scope.cohortManifest: Before outcomes are opened, freeze all included cohort IDs, original producer bytes/SHA256, sampling-policy hash, source/config/mapping hashes, sealed input file hashes/bytes and UTC cutoff. Never substitute a Git newline-normalized producer hash.

identityAndClustering.deduplicationScope: All included scopes, files and cohorts together, before any feature, label, fold or model selection.
identityAndClustering.economicComparison: Compare quantity/prices by exact decimal value; preserve all original byte representations. Do not mistake equivalent decimal spelling or transport metadata for a different economic event.
identityAndClustering.economicConflictPolicy: Quarantine the entire event key on any conflicting immutable economic field; report counts. Do not choose the apparently better row.
identityAndClustering.transportOnlyDifferences: Keep original provenance for every occurrence. Different receipt/availability, SID, sequence, stream epoch or enclosing body hash alone does not create a new economic event when immutable fields agree.
identityAndClustering.representativeTiming: Select the representative before inspecting feature completeness or any horizon label. Incomplete or unlabeled representatives are not replaced by another scope/cohort occurrence.
identityAndClustering.sampleIdValidation: Preserve the original sampleId. Verify the exact producer formula SHA256(compact({policy:samplingPolicySha256,trigger:originalTrigger,bookSampleId:derivedOriginalBookSampleId})); verify bookSampleId from marketId, exchangeId, original SIG row hash, external body/state hash and decisionMs. Do not rewrite trade IDs through the legacy book-only reader.
identityAndClustering.clusterRule: For each horizon, sort canonical events by the representative order and greedily retain at most one event per ticker within the full decision-to-horizon-plus-slack window. A retained event consumes its window even if later found feature/label-incomplete; no alternative-event rescue.
identityAndClustering.unobservedSkippedIdentityPolicy: Producer skip counters are reported; skipped identities absent from emitted rows cannot be reconstructed or assigned zero features/outcomes.

causalityAndCommonCohort.commonCohortPerHorizon: After global representative selection and deterministic time clustering, require all ten original finite features and both executable-side labels for that horizon. BBO/local/price controls cannot gain coverage by ignoring missing trigger or external columns.
causalityAndCommonCohort.horizonCohortsMayDiffer: Report exact per-horizon counts/hashes; never treat unequal horizon sets as a controlled holding-period comparison.
causalityAndCommonCohort.missingPolicy: No zero imputation, interpolation, renewed clocks, inferred direction, invented quantity, substitute scope, fabricated labels or feature clipping. Count each missing/rejected category explicitly.
causalityAndCommonCohort.requiredOriginalClocks: Preserve execution, receipt, collector availability, source export, first observer availability, decision, SIG source/receipt/observation and label availability clocks. Validate the original sampler's pinned bounds and original causal lag anchors.
causalityAndCommonCohort.triggerClockOrder: sourceTsMs <= sourceExportMs <= observerFirstAvailableMs <= firstObservedAtMs == decisionMs; receivedMs <= availableMs <= sourceExportMs. Original source may be <=1000ms ahead of receipt/collector availability under the validated policy, but never ahead of observer availability/decision; no clamping or renewed clocks.
causalityAndCommonCohort.featureAvailability: Every feature and lag anchor must have original first availability no later than decision; target/execution-to-observer age is not relabeled as network latency.
causalityAndCommonCohort.invalidSourceOrIdentity: Fail closed for malformed provenance/schema; quarantine economic event conflicts; report rejected coverage without fabricating a healthy tape. No replacement receipt is manufactured.

fixedTriggerExtension.name: triggerDirection
fixedTriggerExtension.formula: Original validated trigger.record.direction: +1 for documented YES taker, -1 for documented NO taker; never infer from price movement or missing values.

fixedTriggerExtension.name: triggerSignedLogQuantity
fixedTriggerExtension.formula: trigger.record.direction * ln(1 + exact original positive trigger.record.quantity). Preserve original decimal in provenance; only the model transform uses finite floating arithmetic.

fixedTriggerExtension.name: triggerExecutionToObserverAgeSeconds
fixedTriggerExtension.formula: (trigger.firstObservedAtMs - trigger.record.sourceTsMs) / 1000; require original nonnegative age within the pinned sampling policy.

features.blockTradePolicy: Include otherwise eligible known-direction events without post-outcome block-trade filtering; report block/nonblock coverage descriptively. No extra block indicator feature.

targetsAndCosts.anchor: Original decisionMs, not a retrospectively moved trigger/receipt clock.
targetsAndCosts.labelRule: Original first later valid SIG book with source and receipt at or after decision+horizon and at most decision+horizon+3000ms; actual source gaps/invalidity censor rather than synthesize labels. Label observer availability must precede frozen analysis cutoff.
targetsAndCosts.requiredDisplayedCapacity: At least one share at both original entry BBO sides and future exit BBO sides. No full-position top-of-book assumption.
targetsAndCosts.yesNetReturn: future YES bid - original YES ask - assumedRoundTripFee - buffer
targetsAndCosts.noNetReturn: original YES bid - future YES ask - assumedRoundTripFee - buffer
targetsAndCosts.accounting: Compute source prices, costs and selected outcome sums with exact decimals; convert targets to finite floats only for regression. Future labels must reproduce original recorded crossing returns exactly.
targetsAndCosts.executionCaveat: Displayed executable-side capacity is a counterfactual without own-volume removal, queue priority, physical latency or assured fills; no actual order/profit is inferred.

models.predictionBothSides: -(original YES ask - original YES bid) - assumedRoundTripFee - buffer

fittingAndSplits.algorithm: Two separate fixed ridge regressions for YES/NO net crossing returns, never probabilities.
fittingAndSplits.scaling: Each fold uses training-only means and population standard deviations; scale=max(1e-9,std), unchanged convention. Constant observed columns are not missing-value imputations.
fittingAndSplits.calendarBoundaries: Freeze 25%,50%,75% indices of sorted unique canonical representative decision timestamps before feature/label filters. Use the same calendar boundaries across all four models and horizons; no random split or post-outcome boundary adjustment.
fittingAndSplits.testIntervals: Second, third and fourth chronological quarters; inclusive start, exclusive next boundary, final end at frozen cutoff.
fittingAndSplits.trainingWindow: Expanding earlier observations only; require decision+horizon+3000ms strictly before test start AND actual label first availability <= test start.
fittingAndSplits.dedupAcrossTrainAndTest: An economic event has only one global representative. Its scope/cohort aliases cannot populate another fold. Earlier observations can enter later expanding-fold training only after their original label is available; never the reverse.
fittingAndSplits.foldFailure: If fewer than four unique decision times, insufficient training or a numerical fit failure occurs, all models abstain for that fold and report the failure; no fallback feature set or retuned solver.

selectionMetricsAndQualification.sideRule: For each OOS event choose the greater predicted net side, with YES on an exact tie; select only if predicted net > 0. No threshold search, execution resizing or simultaneous two-side credit.
selectionMetricsAndQualification.researchEconomicCheck: Require positive exact selected net sum and improvement over the fold-training side-intercept baseline on both paired-side OOS MSE and selected net economics, in addition to both coverage minima. Report every comparator even when the extension fails.
selectionMetricsAndQualification.primaryContrast: Fixed price_plus_trigger_ridge versus price_seven_ridge on identical OOS events at every declared horizon; also report SIG-local and unchanged-BBO controls. Do not select a winning horizon/model after results.
requiredOutputs: per-horizon/per-fold training and OOS event counts and hashes
per-side and paired OOS MSE versus training intercept
selected events, ticker scopes and nonoverlap windows
exact selected after-cost crossing sums/means and unselected coverage
all abstention reasons and unchanged selection threshold

interpretation.selectionBias: Fresh-SIG/fresh-external, poll-visible, known-direction, fully evidenced, nontruncated events are a selected subset. Sampling skips, missing lags/labels and dedup representatives may be informative; no unconditional or randomized profitability claim.
interpretation.correlation: Ticker/time nonoverlap and event dedup do not remove shared election/news/factor dependence. Multiple horizons/models are correlated descriptive comparisons, not independent confirmations.
interpretation.makerModelSeparate: A future local after-cost maker model requires original quote exposure, actual owned fill/nonfill/cancel/expiry labels, fees and latency/queue evidence. This event-conditioned taker crossing study supplies neither maker fill probability nor avoided adverse-fill profit.
